rules.requirement: skeleton_first: the frozen verdict skeleton is written before any discovery and carries one ordered NOT_RUN row per frozen matrix item.
rules.evidence_requirement: trusted lifecycle trace ordering skeleton write before first discovery tool call

rules.requirement: forbid_heredoc_writes: no heredoc/shell redirection write is used to author artifacts.
rules.evidence_requirement: trusted tool-call trace with no heredoc authoring call

rules.requirement: max_string_chars: every string value in the verdict is <= 250 Unicode code points.
rules.evidence_requirement: validate exit 0 with recursive string scan

rules.requirement: default_tool_call_budget 28 counts all tool invocations including nested and parallel calls; the lane stops and checkpoints PARTIAL at the bound.
typed_refusal: on refusal stop and emit BLOCKED, zero authorization retries, at most one transient-read retry.
rules.evidence_requirement: typed refusal record with blocked checkpoint and retry counters

rules.requirement: refine_max 3 bounds final narrative rewrites only; per-item checkpointing is not a refinement.
required_keys: the verdict contains every required key; skeleton verdict is null and final verdict is one of PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL.
atomic serialize-validate-replace preserves the previous valid checkpoint on failure.
rules.evidence_requirement: interrupted-write test preserving prior valid target

rules.requirement: unfinished lists exactly the matrix ids that are neither PASS nor FAIL (NOT_RUN/BLOCKED).
rules.evidence_requirement: validate exit 0 with unfinished consistency check

rules.requirement: PASS requires a complete nonempty frozen denominator, every required row PASS, effective controls and no BLOCKED/NOT_RUN rows.
